headline: Skills over certificates: Alausa urges competent workforce
ticker: Minister Alausa · skills drive growth · 87,000 trainees · 9jaBeacon · www.9jabeacon.name.ng

narration.text: Good evening from the 9jaBeacon desk. Education Minister Tunji Alausa says Nigeria needs competent workers, not just paper certificates, to drive growth. Over eighty-seven thousand trainees have completed skills programmes. The minister is pushing practical training as a national priority. We will keep following this story.
